services.desc: , race, or socialize - there's no better way to spend your summer than with TISC! As a TISC Sailing Member, you'll have access to our fleet of Albacores, Lasers and Hobies and our spectacularly located clubhouse on the Toronto Island. Between our unique Social Sailing program, certified CANSail courses, Racing programs and our Social Events, TISC has something for every sailor at any skill level. To determine what makes sense for you, view the different types of membership available.
